Team —

Thanks — copying availability notes. I reached out to Rosewood events manager (Samantha) and looked at one other option (The Battery private dining). Quick notes:

- Rosewood parlor is available both 9/16 and 9/23 evenings, private room, max 30, sample tasting menu $125/pp, AV package included in private room rate. Contact: Samantha Price.
- Battery has a quieter parlor but smaller capacity (max 20) and higher per-head menu.

I've attached the guest list and a very rough budget line. If we go Rosewood I can ask them to send the standard contract and confirm whether they will sign our NDA.

Subject: Re: Parlor booking — NDA draft

Dylan / Marissa —

Attached is a draft venue NDA I prepared (Redwood_Venue_NDA_v1.docx). Key points:

- We limit use of attendee names/emails to event coordination only. Venue must not repurpose list for marketing.
- Standard 2-year confidentiality term; can shorten to 1 year if venue pushes back.
- Add mutual indemnification carve-out for food/alcohol service — ask operations if they want stronger language.

If Rosewood requests their own contract we can redline, but I prefer we get the NDA signed ahead of sharing any guest contact details.

Olga

Subject: Parlor booking inquiry — Redwood executive dinner (Sept)

Samantha —

Thanks for taking my call earlier. We're planning a small Redwood host dinner (20–25 attendees) for a mix of customers and prospects (Finx Analytics, Alta Solutions, and a few VC guests). Date options: 16 or 23 September (evenings). Can you confirm:

1) Private parlor availability for either date
2) Sample menu (vegetarian/gluten-free options) and per-head pricing
3) AV and seating layout options (we need a small stage for a 10-min CEO intro + mics)
4) Deposit amount and cancellation terms
5) Whether you can sign a venue NDA before we share the attendee roster

I'm attaching our working guest list (names + org only). Happy to set a 20-minute call tomorrow if that's easier.

Attachments: guest_list_master.xlsx

Best —
Dylan Brooks

Subject: Re: Parlor booking inquiry — Redwood executive dinner (Sept)

Dylan —

Thanks for reaching out. We have the parlor available both 9/16 and 9/23. High-level answers below and I've attached our standard contract for private events.

- Menu / pricing: $125/pp tasting menu; vegetarian and GF options included. Wine pairing available as an add-on.
- AV: small podium + wired lapel mic + house speakers — included for private room bookings.
- Deposit & cancellation: standard deposit is $5,000 to secure date; refundable up to 21 days (minus admin fee).
- NDA: we can sign a short venue NDA. We prefer to receive your form for initial review.

Attached: Rosewood_Standard_Contract_v1.pdf
DocuSign link for contract / deposit instructions: https://na.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123Rosewood

If you'd like me to run through menu options on a call, I'm free Thursday 10–11am or Friday 2–4pm.

Best regards,
Samantha Price
Senior Events Manager | Rosewood Hotel San Francisco

Samantha / team —

Thanks — this is great. Quick internal decisions:

- Proceed with Rosewood on 9/23 (preferred for exec schedules).
- We will request a negotiated deposit cap of $2,500 (Samantha, would you be open to splitting the $5k deposit or applying $2.5k as initial hold with the remainder due 14 days prior?).
- Olga: please redline the Rosewood contract for the attendee-data clause; attached is our NDA signed by Redwood (NDA_Redwood_Venue_signed.pdf). Samantha, if you can countersign the NDA we can share attendee contact emails and move forward with invitations.

Marissa — please move forward with booking once we have countersigned NDA and agree deposit terms. Vivek/Finance: please standby for deposit approval up to $2.5k.

Thanks all,
Dylan
